1.w: I love the Lord because he heard my plea for mercy

2.w: and listened to me. As long as I live, I will call to him when I need help.

3.w: The ropes of death tightened around me, the snares of Sheol confronted me. I was confronted with trouble and sorrow.

4.w: I called on the name of the Lord, “Please, Lord, rescue my life!”

5.w: The Lord is merciful and fair; our God is compassionate.

6.w: The Lord protects the untrained; I was in serious trouble and he delivered me.

7.w: Rest once more, my soul, for the Lord has vindicated you.

8.w: Yes, Lord, you rescued my life from death, kept my eyes from tears and my feet from stumbling.

9.w: I will serve the Lord in the land of the living.

10.w: I had faith when I said, “I am severely oppressed.”

11.w: I rashly declared, “All men are liars.”

12.w: How can I repay the Lord for all his acts of kindness to me?

13.w: I will celebrate my deliverance and call on the name of the Lord.

14.w: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord before all his people.

15.w: The Lord values the lives of his faithful followers.

16.w: Yes, Lord! I am indeed your servant; I am your servant, the son of your female servant. You saved me from death.

17.w: I will present a thank offering to you, and call on the name of the Lord.

18.w: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord before all his people,

19.w: in the courts of the Lord’s temple, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the Lord!
